# Cncf Thundra Reviewer

Review Thundra using its official documentation and repository in the Serverless / Tools category. Thundra helps answer your toughest questions about the health of your Serverless infrastructure by giving you invaluable insights into your AWS Lambda functions.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
